issue_title: Header "Transfer-Encoding: chunked" set even if Content-Length is provided which causes body to not actually get chunked
issue_body:
When making a request with both a body and a Content-Length header, Requests incorrectly adds Transfer-Encoding: chunked, which causes the body to not actually get chunked as expected. This breaks compatibility with servers that expect proper chunked encoding when the header is present.

Reproduction:
```python
import requests
import json

headers = {'Content-Length': '13', 'Content-Type': 'application/json'}
data = json.dumps({'test': 'data'})
response = requests.post('https://httpbin.org/post', data=data, headers=headers)
```

The resulting request has both Content-Length and Transfer-Encoding: chunked, which is invalid per HTTP/1.1 specifications (RFC 7230 Section 3.3.2).
description: Prevent setting Transfer-Encoding: chunked when Content-Length is explicitly provided
